facts.statement: LCR bit 7 is Divisor Latch Access bit RW.
DLAB value 1 allows divisor latches to be accessed.
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The divisor latches can be accessed

facts.statement: DLAB value 0 selects normal registers access.
UART core uses 8-bit data bus for compatibility as WISHBONE responder.
facts.quote: It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.
